title.en: Send every plain-HTTP request to HTTPS

detail.en: The site answers over plain HTTP as if it were fine. One server rule sends every such request to the HTTPS address instead.

forwardable.en: Or forward it to your developer — it reads the same either way.

body.en:
On {{domain}}, plain-HTTP requests are answered with the page instead of a redirect to HTTPS. Change the server so that every request on port 80 answers with a permanent redirect to the same path on https://{{domain}}, and nothing else. Do not touch the HTTPS server block.

When you are done: show me the change, and tell me how to confirm that http://{{domain}}/ and http://{{domain}}/{{path}} both answer with a redirect to https.
